title: Product Liability due to Manufacturing Defect

content.scenario: Rahul purchased a smartphone from a retail store in Mumbai, which exploded due to a manufacturing defect. He suffered severe burns and filed a complaint against the manufacturer.
content.outcome: The court may hold the manufacturer liable for the harm caused, as the product contained a manufacturing defect, which is a ground for product liability under Section 84(1)(a) of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019. The manufacturer may be required to produce manufacturing specifications and production records to prove that the product did not deviate from the intended design.
